# SPEC-CI-MINIMAL (specs/SPEC-CI-MINIMAL-2026-10-13.md): the harness
# (stanok/launcher/tests_harness) must run green on a bare runner — no
# k8s cluster, no docker, no jq, no repo .venv. The contract is the exact
# SET of skipped-test nodeids ("<path>.py::<test-name>", extracted from the
# junit-xml report by launcher/ci_skips.py — position-independent revision
# 2026-10-20: line numbers no longer participate, editing a test file can
# no longer redden CI by moving a skip statement). The environment probes
# skip with reasons (skip-guards in the tests), and ANY change of the set —
# a substitution at the same count included — fails CI. The count (exactly
# 11) is kept as a secondary check.
# Revision 2026-10-22 (SPEC-DOCTOR-CLI-VERSION-2026-10-22): the CLI version
# gate test_image_cli_version_matches_packaged_version was added under
# _NO_DOCKER — the set and the secondary count went 10 -> 11.
# Provenance of this list: generated 2026-10-20 by launcher/ci_skips.py over
# a local CI-emulation run (fresh published-layout clone, Python 3.11 +
# image-requirements.lock, docker/jq/kubectl hidden from PATH): "672 passed,
# 10 skipped" — the same set the GitHub runs 39409333271/39284348010
# reported positionally before the format change.
# The workflow lives in the PARENT repo: the guard test
# test_supervisor_zone_not_published needs the published-parent layout
# (parent checkout + stanok submodule) — a stanok-only CI cannot run it.
